references.text: Jeremiah also warns about the consequences of leading others to fall, which reflects the warning in Matthew
Luke gives a similar warning about being the cause of others' stumbling, which mirrors the message in Matthew
Mark contains a parallel warning about leading the little ones to fall, consistent with the warning in Matthew
Matthew speaks of removing everything that leads to sin, which is related to the warning about stumbling blocks
Revelation warns about temptations that are coming, which can be seen in light of the warning about stumbling blocks in Matthew
